Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Goblet squat – paused
2 sets8-10 repsAny kit5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hold a weight at the chest with both hands, elbows tucked, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit down into a squat, pause for two to three seconds at the bottom holding still, then drive up through the heels to stand.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes and the heels down through the pause. Keep the chest up and the weight close, and pause only at a depth you control comfortably.

Romanian deadlift – BB
2 sets6-8 repsBarbell10kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with a barbell held at the front of your thighs, hands just outside your legs, feet hip-width. Set the shoulders back, brace the core hard, and keep a soft bend in the knees.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the bar down the front of your legs, keeping it in contact, until you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings. Keep the knees still and the shins vertical. Drive the hips forward to stand tall and finish with the glutes.

Focus: The back stays flat from start to finish, never rounded. This is a hip hinge, not a squat, so the movement happens at the hips while the bar tracks close to the legs. Only lower as far as you can hold a flat back, and don't lean back or over-arch at the top.

Push press – DB
2 sets6-8 repsDB2 x 5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at the shoulders, palms facing in, feet hip-width, ribs down, core and glutes braced.

Movement: Dip slightly at the knees, then drive up through the legs to help press the dumbbells overhead, then lower under control.

Focus: Use a short controlled leg dip and drive, keeping the ribs down and not arching the back on the press. Keep the knees in line with the middle toes, press both dumbbells evenly, and control the lower to the shoulders.

Reverse fly – single arm
2 sets8-10 each sideDB or similar3kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back, a light dumbbell in one hand hanging below the chest, elbow softly bent, other hand supporting.

Movement: Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height, squeezing the shoulder blade, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep a soft elbow bend and lead with the back of the hand, squeezing the shoulder blade. Keep the back flat and don't swing or shrug, using a light weight.

Hip abduction – band, standing
2 sets8-10 repsBandRed band
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand with a band around the ankles or lower legs, holding a support, torso tall.

Movement: Take the working leg out to the side against the band, keeping it straight, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the leg straight and the torso tall, not leaning to lift, and the hips level. Lead with the heel, keep it slow, and feel the outer hip.

Sit-up
2 sets8-10 repsMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, hands across the chest or lightly behind the head, ribs down.

Movement: Curl up from the floor one vertebra at a time until the torso is upright over the hips, then lower back down under control.

Focus: Curl rather than swing, keeping the neck neutral and the feet down without hooking them under anything. Lower slowly instead of dropping, and stop short of the range if the lower back complains.

w/c 23 Nov 2026 · Hinge & Pull & Carry
Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Romanian deadlift
2 sets8-10 repsAny kit~5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, holding a weight in front of your thighs, or hands empty, with a soft bend in the knees. Set the shoulders back and brace the core.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the weight down the front of your legs, keeping it close, until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, never let it round. The movement is a hip hinge, not a squat, and the weight stays close to your legs. Only go as low as you can keep the back flat.

Row – BB, bent-over
2 sets8-10 repsBarbellModerate
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a barbell at arms' length, chest up, hips back, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the lower chest or upper abdomen, driving the elbows back, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady, not rising or rounding as you row, this protects the lower back. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and control the lower.

Farmer's hold
2 sets30sAny kitModerate
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with your feet hip-width, holding a weight in each hand by your sides, shoulders back and down, core braced.

Movement: Stand still and hold the weights for the set time, breathing steadily.

Focus: Stay tall with your shoulders level and drawn down, not shrugging or rounding forward. Keep your ribs down, grip firmly, and put the weights down under control before your grip gives.

Biceps curl
2 sets8-10 repsAny kit/BandLight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with a weight in each hand at the sides, or standing on a band holding the handles, elbows pinned to the ribs, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Curl the weights up towards the shoulders, keeping the elbows still, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the elbows pinned to the sides and don't swing the body to lift. Keep the ribs down, and control the lower rather than dropping.

Terminal knee extension
2 sets8-10 repsBandLight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand with a band around the back of one knee anchored in front, a slight bend in that knee, holding a support.

Movement: Straighten the knee fully against the band, squeezing the thigh, then let it bend slightly under control.

Focus: Focus on fully straightening the knee and squeezing the front of the thigh hard at the top. Keep it slow and controlled, stay tall, and keep the movement pain-free.

Dead bug – arms and legs
2 sets8-10 each sideMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent over the hips, arms towards the ceiling, lower back pressed gently into the floor.

Movement: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly towards the floor, keeping the back flat, then return and swap sides.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor as the limbs extend, never letting it arch. Move slowly and controlled, and shorten the reach if the back lifts.

Box squat – goblet
How to
3 x 8-1010kg

Start: Stand in front of a box at about parallel height holding a weight at the chest, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then drive up through the heels to stand tall, keeping the weight at the chest.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes and the heels down. Touch the box under control rather than dropping, and keep the chest up and the weight close throughout.

Calf raises – bent knee
How to
2 x 8-10Bodyweight

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, holding a support, knees soft and bent throughout.

Movement: Press through the balls of the feet and lift the heels, then lower slowly over three seconds. Progress to the edge of a step so the heels can drop below the toes.

Focus: Hold the knee bend the whole way. If the legs straighten as you rise, the work moves up into the bulky calf and away from the deep muscle you are after.

Curl and press
How to
2 x 8-10Moderate

Start: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, elbows pinned in, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Curl both weights to the shoulders, then press them overhead until the arms are straight, then reverse both to return.

Focus: Keep the ribs down through the press rather than arching the back, and keep the shoulders down away from the ears. Control the curl and the press, and do not let the knees or hips help the weight up.

Single leg deadlift – supported, hold
How to
3 x 30s each sideBodyweight

Start: Stand on one leg, soft knee, weight held in front of the thigh, fingertips on a chair back or worktop in front of you.

Movement: Hinge at the hip and lower the weight down the standing leg while the free leg lifts behind, reach a flat-backed stretch, then hold still.

Focus: Back flat, hips level, don't let the raised hip open out. Light fingertip support only, enough to steady you, and take the hand away when you feel steady.

Push-up – kneeling
How to
3 x 8-10Bodyweight

Start: Kneel on a mat with hands under the shoulders and knees behind the hips, body in a straight line from head to knees, core and glutes braced.

Movement: Bend the elbows to lower the chest towards the floor, then press back up to straight arms, keeping the line.

Focus: Keep the line from head to knees without the hips sagging or piking. Keep the elbows tucked to about 45 degrees and lower to a comfortable chest depth.

Hand plank – shoulder taps
How to
2 x 8-10 each sideBodyweight

Start: Set up in a hand plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels. Set your feet a little wider than your hips.

Movement: Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, put it back, then do the same with the other hand. Keep alternating for the set reps.

Focus: Keep your hips still and level as each hand lifts, not rocking side to side or lifting your bottom. Brace your middle, squeeze your glutes, and move slowly.

w/c 16 Nov 2026 · Hinge & Pull & CarryHinge & Pull & Carryw/c 16 Nov · 1 log by James▼
Logged by James
Pull-through – band
How to
3 x 8-10Red

Start: Stand facing away from a low band, the band between the legs held in both hands, hinged forward with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Drive the hips forward to stand tall, pulling the band through, squeezing the glutes, then hinge back under control.

Focus: Drive the movement from the hips and glutes, not the arms or lower back, keeping the back flat. Stand tall with the ribs down at the top, and control the hinge back.

Hip row – BB
How to
3 x 8-1015kg

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a barbell at arms' length, chest up, core braced, hips back.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the hips, driving the elbows back, then lower under control while holding the hinge.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady throughout, not rising or rounding as you row. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and keep the shoulders down.

Waiter carry – single arm
How to
3 x 20m5kg

Start: Stand tall holding a weight overhead in one hand, arm straight, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the weight stable overhead.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back to hold the weight up, staying tall. Keep the shoulder stable and the arm straight, and resist tipping to either side.

Anterior tibialis – toe raises off a step
How to
2 x 8-10Bodyweight

Start: Stand on a step or box with the heels on the surface and the toes hanging out over the edge. Hold a rail or frame for balance.

Movement: Let the toes lower below the level of the step under control, then pull them up towards the shins as high as they will go.

Focus: This is about range, not load. The edge lets the foot drop below level, which is where the shin has to work hardest and where most people have never trained. Go as low as the ankle allows before pulling back up, and keep the knees straight throughout.

McGill curl-up – slow
How to
3 x 8-10Bodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, one knee bent, one leg straight, hands under the lower back, elbows down.

Movement: Slowly lift the head and shoulders just slightly, hold, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Keep the lower back in its natural arch and brace, lifting only slightly and slowly. Keep the neck neutral, don't pull the chin in, and control every phase.

Lateral raise – side-lying
How to
2 x 8-10 each side5kg

Start: Lie on one side with the head resting on the bottom arm and the knees bent, holding a light weight in the top hand resting on the thigh.

Movement: Raise the top arm up towards the ceiling until it is just short of vertical, then lower slowly to the thigh. Finish the set, then change sides.

Focus: Keep the arm straight but not locked and the shoulder down away from the ear. Move slowly, and stop short of any pinching.

Goblet squat and reach
How to
3 x 10-125kg

Start: Hold a weight at the chest, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit down into a squat and, at the bottom, reach the weight forward to help you sit upright, then draw it back to the chest and stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes and the heels down. Use the reach to stay upright rather than tipping forward, and squat only as deep as the knees allow.

Deadlift
How to
3 x 8-1025kg

Start: Stand with the weight on the floor between your feet, feet hip to shoulder-width. Push the hips back and hinge to take hold of it with both hands, back flat, chest up, shoulders over the weight.

Movement: Drive through the floor and stand tall, pushing the hips forward and squeezing the glutes at the top. Hinge the hips back to lower the weight under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat from start to finish, never rounded. The power comes from the hips and legs, not the lower back or arms. Keep the weight close to your body on the way up and down.

Overhead press – standing
How to
3 x 10-127.5kg

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, ribs down, glutes and core braced.

Movement: Press the dumbbells overhead until the arms are straight, then lower back to the shoulders under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and squeeze the glutes so the lower back doesn't arch as you press. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears, and press within a comfortable range.

Balance board – soft board
How to
3 x 30s each sideBodyweight

Start: Stand on the soft board on one foot, knee soft, torso tall, with a support within reach.

Movement: Hold steady on the one leg for the set time, making small constant corrections from the foot and ankle. Step off and swap sides between sets.

Focus: Let the ankle and foot do the correcting rather than the arms. Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft, and keep a hand near the support until it settles.

Pallof press
How to
3 x 10 each sideLight

Start: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height, feet shoulder-width, hands holding the handle at the chest, core braced.

Movement: Press the handle straight out in front of you, resisting the pull that wants to rotate you, hold briefly, then draw it back.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square, letting nothing rotate you towards the cable, this is the whole exercise. Keep the ribs down and the core braced, and press smoothly rather than snatching.

Elbow plank
How to
3 x 30sBodyweight

Start: Set your forearms on the floor shoulder-width, elbows under the shoulders, legs extended back, toes tucked under.

Movement: Lift the hips to form a straight line from head to heels and hold that position for the set time, breathing steadily.

Focus: Keep a straight line, hips neither sagging down nor piking up, and the core and glutes braced. Keep the ribs down and the neck long, and stop when the line breaks rather than pushing through a drooping back.

Bent-over row
How to
3 x 10-122 x 10kg

Start: Feet hip-width, a weight in each hand. Push the hips back and hinge until the chest is well forward, back flat, arms hanging below the shoulders.

Movement: Pull the weight towards the lower ribs, driving the elbows back, then lower under control without standing up.

Focus: Hold the hinge still for the whole set, back flat, no bobbing up to help the lift. Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top and keep the neck long.

Split squat – bodyweight
How to
3 x 8 each sideBodyweight

Start: Stand in a split stance, one foot forward and one back, weight balanced, torso tall, hands at the chest or on the hips.

Movement: Lower straight down until both knees are bent towards right angles, back knee towards the floor, then drive up through the front heel to the start. Stay in the split stance for every rep.

Focus: Keep the front knee over the ankle and tracking over the foot, not caving in, and the torso upright. Keep the weight balanced between the legs, lower under control, and drive up through the front heel.

Suitcase carry
How to
3 x 20m20kg

Start: Stand tall with a weight in one hand at the side like a suitcase, feet hip-width, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso upright and level.

Focus: Resist the pull towards the weighted side, keeping the shoulders and hips level and the ribs down. Take steady steps, brace hard, and don't let the weight swing.

Hip abduction – standing band
How to
3 x 10 each sideRed

Start: Stand with a band around the ankles or lower legs, holding a support, torso tall.

Movement: Take the working leg out to the side against the band, keeping it straight, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the leg straight and the torso tall, not leaning to lift, and the hips level. Lead with the heel, keep it slow, and feel the outer hip.

Dorsiflexion – banded
How to
3 x 10Black

Start: Sit on the floor, working leg straight. Loop a band round the ball of the foot, anchored ahead of you so it pulls the foot away.

Movement: Pull the toes and forefoot back towards the shin against the band, then let it draw the foot slowly back out.

Focus: Keep the knee still and move only at the ankle. The slow return matters as much as the pull. Start with a light band, this muscle tires fast.

Glute bridge – bilateral
How to
3 x 10Bodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, close enough that your fingertips brush your heels.

Movement: Drive through your heels and push your hips towards the ceiling until knees, hips and shoulders form a straight line. Squeeze the glutes, hold two seconds, then lower slowly.

Focus: Lift with the glutes, not by arching the lower back. Keep the ribs down and the core braced. Stop at a straight line, don't push on into the back.

Goblet squat – pulse
How to
3 x 10-125kg

Start: Hold a weight at the chest, elbows tucked, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Squat to a comfortable depth and pulse up and down through a small range at the bottom for the set count, then stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes and the heels down through every pulse. Keep the chest up and the weight close, and pulse only within a depth the knees tolerate.

Romanian deadlift – BB
How to
3 x 8-1010kg

Start: Stand tall with a barbell held at the front of your thighs, hands just outside your legs, feet hip-width. Set the shoulders back, brace the core hard, and keep a soft bend in the knees.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the bar down the front of your legs, keeping it in contact, until you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings. Keep the knees still and the shins vertical. Drive the hips forward to stand tall and finish with the glutes.

Focus: The back stays flat from start to finish, never rounded. This is a hip hinge, not a squat, so the movement happens at the hips while the bar tracks close to the legs. Only lower as far as you can hold a flat back, and don't lean back or over-arch at the top.

Chest press – band, standing
How to
3 x 10-12Black band

Start: Anchor a band behind you, a handle in each hand at chest height, staggered stance, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Press the hands forward until the arms are nearly straight, then return under control to the chest.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set and the ribs down, not arching to press. Keep the elbows a little below shoulder height, and control the band on the return.

Soleus – isometric hold
How to
3 x 30sBodyweight

Start: Sit on a chair, feet flat, knees bent to about a right angle. Everything above the ankles relaxed.

Movement: Press the balls of the feet down, lift the heels and hold at about half effort. Build into the hold, and lower under control.

Focus: The gentlest way to load the deep calf, and it suits an ankle that is still being careful. No impact, so it can be done often. Little and often rather than hard.

Straight arm raise
How to
3 x 10-125kg

Start: Stand tall holding a weight in both hands at the thighs, arms straight, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Raise the weight forward and up to about shoulder height with straight arms, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with straight arms and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging, raising only to shoulder height. Keep the ribs down and don't lean back, and control the lower.

Sit-up and twist
How to
3 x 10-12Bodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, hands across the chest or lightly behind the head, ribs down.

Movement: Curl up until the torso is upright, turning towards one side at the top, then lower under control and alternate sides.

Focus: Turn from the trunk rather than throwing the elbow, and keep the neck neutral throughout. Lower slowly, and keep the range comfortable rather than forcing the rotation.

Romanian deadlift – staggered stance
How to
3 x 10-12Moderate

Start: One foot flat, the other half a step back on its toes. Weight in front of the thighs, soft bend in the front knee.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the weight down the front leg until the hamstring loads, then drive the hips forward to stand tall. Swap legs halfway.

Focus: Most of the weight sits on the front leg, the back foot is only there for balance. Back flat, hips square, not twisting open.

Row – band, single arm, split stance
How to
3 x 10-12 each sideLight

Start: Anchor a band at chest height. Stand in a split stance facing it, the foot opposite the working arm forward, band in one hand, arm straight.

Movement: Pull the hand towards the ribs, driving the elbow back, then let the arm straighten slowly against the band. Swap sides halfway.

Focus: The split stance is the point. The band tries to turn you towards it, so keep the hips and shoulders square and the trunk still. Only the arm moves.

Farmer's carries
How to
3 x 20mModerate

Start: Stand tall holding a heavy weight in each hand at the sides, feet hip-width, ribs down, shoulders back.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso tall and steady.

Focus: Stand tall with the ribs down and shoulders back, not letting the weights pull you into a slump. Take steady steps, brace the core, and keep the weights from swinging.

External rotation – band
How to
3 x 10-12Light

Start: Stand side-on to a band at elbow height, elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees, forearm across the body.

Movement: Rotate the forearm outward, opening away from the body, keeping the elbow pinned, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow glued to the side and move only the forearm, not the whole arm. Keep the shoulder down and the ribs still, and control the return.

Glute kickback – band
How to
3 x 10-12Light

Start: Loop a band around your ankles or hold it under the standing foot. Stand tall, hands on a support for balance, slight bend in the standing knee.

Movement: Push one leg back against the band using the glute, keeping it fairly straight, then return with control.

Focus: Squeeze the glute at the back and keep the movement at the hip. Don't arch the lower back or swing the leg to cheat the range.

Dead bug – arms and legs
How to
3 x 10-12 each sideBodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent over the hips, arms towards the ceiling, lower back pressed gently into the floor.

Movement: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly towards the floor, keeping the back flat, then return and swap sides.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor as the limbs extend, never letting it arch. Move slowly and controlled, and shorten the reach if the back lifts.

Box squat – weighted
How to
3 x 10-12Light

Start: Stand in front of a box at about knee height holding a light weight at the chest, feet hip to shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then stand tall through the heels, keeping the weight at the chest.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the chest up. Sit back under control rather than dropping onto the box, and drive up through the heels.

Suitcase deadlift
How to
3 x 10-12 each sideModerate

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, a single weight on the floor beside one foot.

Movement: Hinge and bend the knees to take the weight, then drive through the floor and stand tall with it at your side. Lower under control. Swap sides halfway.

Focus: The load is on one side, so the trunk has to stop you leaning towards it. Shoulders and hips level all the way, back flat, weight close to the leg.

Overhead press – seated
How to
3 x 10-12~2 x 5kg

Start: Sit tall on a bench with back support, a weight in each hand at shoulder height, elbows under the wrists, ribs down.

Movement: Press the the weights overhead until the arms are straight, then lower them back to shoulder height under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the back against the support, not arching to press. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears, and lower under control to a comfortable shoulder range.

Balance – single leg with arm reach
How to
3 x 30s each sideBodyweight

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, other foot lifted, arms ready to reach.

Movement: Reach the arms (and torso if set) out to the sides or forward, challenging balance, then return to centre.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft as you reach, moving slowly. Fix the eyes on a point, keep the core engaged, and return under control.

Dorsiflexion – banded
How to
3 x 10-12Light

Start: Sit on the floor, working leg straight. Loop a band round the ball of the foot, anchored ahead of you so it pulls the foot away.

Movement: Pull the toes and forefoot back towards the shin against the band, then let it draw the foot slowly back out.

Focus: Keep the knee still and move only at the ankle. The slow return matters as much as the pull. Start with a light band, this muscle tires fast.

Elbow plank – arm reach
How to
3 x 30sBodyweight

Start: Set up in a forearm plank, straight line from head to heels, core and glutes braced.

Movement: Keeping the hips level, reach one arm forward off the floor, hold briefly, return, then the other.

Focus: Keep the hips level and square as you reach, resisting any twist. Keep the ribs down and the core braced, and keep the reach controlled so the line stays straight.

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, the other leg ready to travel back, standing knee soft, arms ready.

Movement: Hinge forward from the hip, letting the free leg travel back and the arms lower, then return to standing.

Focus: Hinge from the hip with a flat back, keeping the hips level and not opening out. Keep the standing knee soft, move slowly, and control the return.

Push-up
How to
3 x 8Bodyweight

Start: Set up with hands under the shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels, core and glutes braced.

Movement: Bend the elbows to lower the chest towards the floor, then press back up to straight arms, keeping the line.

Focus: Keep the body straight, not letting the hips sag or pike. Keep the elbows tucked to about 45 degrees, not flared wide, and lower to a comfortable chest depth.

90/90 hip flow
How to
3 x 8 eachBodyweight

Start: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front at 90 degrees and the other out to the side at 90 degrees, sitting tall.

Movement: Flow the knees from side to side, rotating through both hips, pausing where you feel a gentle stretch, then continuing.

Focus: Move from the hips with the torso tall, easing into each side rather than forcing. Use the hands for support, and stay within a comfortable, pain-free range.

Bicycle twists
How to
3 x 12 eachBodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent up, hands lightly behind the head, elbows wide, ribs down.

Movement: Bring one elbow towards the opposite knee as that knee draws in and the other leg extends, then alternate in a pedalling rhythm.

Focus: Rotate through the trunk and keep the elbows wide, not pulling on the neck. Keep the lower back settled and move at a controlled pace, not rushing.

Balance – single leg with arm reach
How to
3 x 20s eachBodyweight

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, other foot lifted, arms ready to reach.

Movement: Reach the arms (and torso if set) out to the sides or forward, challenging balance, then return to centre.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft as you reach, moving slowly. Fix the eyes on a point, keep the core engaged, and return under control.

Wall sit – static hold
How to
3 x 30sBodyweight

Start: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet a stride out in front and hip-width apart.

Movement: Slide down the wall until your knees are bent towards a right angle, thighs working, and hold the position for the set time.

Focus: Keep the knees stacked over the ankles, not drifting past the toes, and the whole back in contact with the wall. Drop only as low as your knees stay comfortable, and breathe steadily through the hold.

Glute bridges – single leg
How to
3 x 10 eachBodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, one knee bent with the foot flat, the other leg extended straight out and held off the floor.

Movement: Drive through the heel of the bent leg to push your hips up until the body is level. Hold two seconds, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Keep the hips level, don't let the free side drop or twist. Push with the glute, not the lower back, and keep the ribs down.

Ankle alphabet
How to
3 x 10 eachBodyweight

Start: Sit or lie with one leg lifted, the foot free to move, ankle relaxed.

Movement: Slowly trace each letter of the alphabet in the air with the big toe, moving only at the ankle through its full comfortable range.

Focus: Move only at the ankle, keeping the leg still, and work through a comfortable range without forcing. Move slowly and smoothly, and stop short of any sharp pain.

Lunge matrix
How to
3 x 5 each directionModerate

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, a weight held at the chest or hands free for balance.

Movement: Lunge in a set sequence, changing direction each rep (forward, reverse, lateral, angled), lowering under control and pushing back to standing between each.

Focus: Keep the front knee tracking over the foot, never caving in, and the torso tall. Push back to standing through the front heel, and control each direction rather than rushing the sequence.

Push-up plus – floor
How to
3 x 10Bodyweight

Start: Set up in a push-up position, hands under the shoulders, body in a straight line, core braced.

Movement: Perform a push-up, and at the top push a little further to spread the shoulder blades (the plus), then relax and repeat.

Focus: Keep the body in a straight line, not sagging or piking. Keep the elbows tucked to about 45 degrees, and on the plus spread the shoulder blades rather than shrugging.

McGill curl-up – slow
How to
3 x 6 eachBodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, one knee bent, one leg straight, hands under the lower back, elbows down.

Movement: Slowly lift the head and shoulders just slightly, hold, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Keep the lower back in its natural arch and brace, lifting only slightly and slowly. Keep the neck neutral, don't pull the chin in, and control every phase.
